description: This file is a PHP class definition for LocationDao, a Data Access Object responsible for managing Location entities within the OrangeHRM system. It offers methods for retrieving, searching, counting, and manipulating location data, including complex search filters and relations with employee data.

classes.name: LocationDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class providing methods for CRUD operations, searching, and counting Location entities within the database, including complex search filters and relations with employee data.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Retrieves a Location entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingLocationIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing location IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of location records matching specified search filters.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Fetches a list of Location entities based on search filters.

methods.name: searchLocationsPaginator
methods.description: Sets up a query with pagination and sorting based on search filters to support location search and sorting.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns the number of employees associated with a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationsIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a ordered list of all Location IDs.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Gets location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getLocationsByIds
methods.description: Fetches Location entities for a list of location IDs.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Persists a Location entity into the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Deletes Location entities with specified IDs from the database.
